overview.about: The German Grand Prix is held at the Sachsenring, a short, tight and largely anti-clockwise circuit in Saxony that has become one of MotoGP's fortresses. Its many left-handers wear tyres unevenly and reward a very specific set-up, and Marc Marquez was untouchable here with eight premier-class wins. The 2027 race is on 11 July.
overview.nextEvent: The 2027 German Grand Prix runs on 11 July at the Sachsenring near Hohenstein-Ernstthal. The compact, left-hander-heavy layout makes it one of the most distinctive tracks on the calendar.
